objective.name: journal
objective.description: Defines the journal Matter as an element: an append-only Matter in JSON Lines whose substance is the ordered stream of messages of one continuity, one message per line, described line by line by the message schema.

functional._format_note: Required. The substance is JSON Lines: one JSON document per line, each line ending with LF.
functional._schema_ref_note: Required. For a JSON Lines Matter, the schema constraining ONE line of the substance.
functional._framing_note: The engine only knows the LF line boundaries (brique.substance_framing = lines); it never parses the JSON. Lines are added at the tail by matter.append, guarded by expected_line_count.
